name: Infinium Pharmachem Ltd.
summary: Infinium Pharmachem Ltd. is a specialized chemical company engaged in the development, manufacture, and export of a wide range of iodine derivatives and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). The company's core focus is on iodine chemistry, providing over 200 iodine derivatives and more than 15 APIs. It also offers Contract Research and Manufacturing Services (CRAMS), which include research and development, process optimization, scale-up, and commercial-scale manufacturing and packaging for iodine-based compounds. Infinium Pharmachem serves diverse global industries such as pharmaceuticals, specialty and performance chemicals, nutraceuticals, animal feed, agriculture, biotech, cosmetics, electronics, and medical imaging. The company operates an ISO, FDA-approved, and GMP-compliant manufacturing facility in Gujarat, India, and supplies its products to markets across India, Europe, Asia, North America, Central America, the Middle East, and South America.
